result.reason: The edits appropriately extend use to Affiliates and contractors and are otherwise targeted. However, they do not provide that paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach, so the preferred position is not reached. The M&A assignment right is also materially uncertain because the retained Change of Control sentence states that any Change of Control is governed outside this section, potentially overriding the new exception, while the following voidness sentence still purports to invalidate any assignment made without consent. Those sentences should expressly preserve permitted successor assignments. The margin comment cannot cure these operative-language deficiencies.
